linear.notes: Parameters of the staged fit (stage 1 prefit -> stage 2 inverse calibration, epoch 700 of 1000 -> stage 3 regeneration with a fitted Beverton-Holt cap) on two-interval-v8/train. Fitted with FINN 0.2.0 release candidate 6705a50 (fast-setup + F1); extracted as a named parameter list and validated with FINN 0.2.0 main 0848b60, under which fit(weight_scale = 'raw') reproduces the fit objective. parameters.pt is what load_model() rebuilds from; model.pt is the whole stage-3 model object (torch_save) for torch::torch_load() under FINN 6705a50/0848b60. Pinned for simulation: one torch thread and batchsize 1000 (the validation's value); a different batchsize changes the random draws but not the model.
